title: Strawberry Video Player
summary: Plays ~/Videos on HDMI or the LCD, looping, with keyboard controls.
description: Strawberry Video Player plays every video in ~/Videos in alphabetical order and loops. It shows on HDMI when a display is connected and otherwise on the built-in LCD, with sound following the picture. Keys: Tab switches LCD/HDMI, q/Space pause, z/x/Del previous, c/f next, w/e skip 30 s, s/d volume, a mute, l loop one/all, h help, Esc quit. On HDMI the LCD shows an info page with title, progress and volume. For smooth 1080p on HDMI it uses VLC's hardware DRM output when allowed to pause the desktop; otherwise it plays in a desktop window. Hardware decoding is chosen per file; files the Pi cannot decode in hardware (for example H.264 level 5.1) fall back to software automatically.
